en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a coastal town built among rocky hills. Foreground and midground are filled with tiled‑roof houses and a few mid‑rise apartment blocks from the early‑ to mid‑20th century. In the background are more houses scattered over bare rock outcrops, and beyond them a calm sea with low islands on the horizon. The architecture is typical of Northern European/Scandinavian wooden and masonry houses. No visible caption or border appears on the image.
